name: Gold (fear gauge)
summary: Gold near $3,916, down 9.1% over three months as yields and rate hikes weigh
state: Gold futures were near $3,916 on 2 Nov, 9.1% lower over three months and 3.9% down on the week, past the 8% three-month fall that marks Watch. Prices edged up early on 2 Nov as oil fell, but the slide during the Gulf war is consistent with higher yields and Fed tightening rather than a flight to safety.
for_you: Gold prices are falling faster than usual; holders of gold or gold funds are seeing larger value swings.
